title: Seer: Guiding Small Deep-Research Agents with Shared Decision Models
title_zh: Seer：用共享决策模型引导小型深度研究智能体
abstract_en: Deep-research agents repeatedly decide what to search, read, and verify, often using large cloud-hosted language models for action proposal. However, privacy and local control motivate running agents on users' devices, where limited memory and compute favor smaller models and complicate on-device training. Yet inference-time guidance faces three obstacles: exploring alternatives through real execution adds tool calls, prompted self-evaluation is bounded by the agent's judgment, and model-specific guidance risks repeated adaptation costs. We introduce Seer, an inference-time framework providing local guidance that separates the agent's action proposal from learned consequence prediction and value estimation. From a shared corpus of real research trajectories, we train two models: a tool-response simulator on observed call--response pairs and a value estimator on histories labeled with discounted terminal correctness. The simulator and estimator are trained offline and reused across agents without further training. Moreover, Seer executes only the selected action and adds only real tool responses to the committed history, avoiding tool calls on discarded candidates at additional inference cost. Across multiple deep-research benchmarks, Seer substantially improves agent performance for different language models. For instance, GAIA accuracy rises from 13.6% to 41.7% for Qwen3.5-4B and from 22.3% to 50.5% for Qwen3.5-9B. Furthermore, our analyses suggest that broader candidate coverage can compensate for imperfect simulation, while prediction and scoring errors limit the benefits of wider imagined search. These findings highlight the potential of reusable models for prediction and evaluation to strengthen small research agents through extra local computation without the real execution of the discarded candidates.
abstract_zh: 深度研究智能体需要反复决定搜索什么、阅读什么以及核实什么。为保护隐私并保留本地控制权，可以让智能体在用户设备上运行，但有限的内存和算力更适合小模型，也使端侧训练更加困难。现有的推理时引导面临三项障碍：实际执行备选动作会增加工具调用，提示式自评受限于智能体自身的判断能力，而针对特定模型的引导可能需要反复适配。本文提出 Seer，将智能体提出候选动作的过程与后果预测、价值评估分开。Seer 利用共享的真实研究轨迹离线训练两个模型：工具响应模拟器从实际调用及其响应中学习，价值估计器则使用按最终答案正确性折扣标注的历史轨迹进行训练。两个模型可跨智能体复用，无需额外训练。Seer 以额外的本地推理开销换取候选动作的模拟评估，只实际执行选中的动作，也只将真实工具响应写入历史。在多个深度研究基准上，Seer 提升了不同语言模型驱动的智能体表现。例如，在 GAIA 上，Qwen3.5-4B 的准确率从 13.6% 提升至 41.7%，Qwen3.5-9B 从 22.3% 提升至 50.5%。分析表明，扩大候选动作的覆盖范围可以部分弥补模拟不准的问题，但预测和评分误差会限制进一步扩大模拟搜索的收益。
key_points_zh: Seer 将候选动作生成与后果预测、价值评估解耦，让小模型借助外部决策信号筛选动作，而不只依赖自身判断。
工具响应模拟器和价值估计器基于共享的真实研究轨迹离线训练，可跨智能体复用，无需额外训练。
只对选中的动作发起真实工具调用，且不将模拟响应写入历史；代价是增加本地推理开销。
在 GAIA 上，Qwen3.5-4B 和 Qwen3.5-9B 的准确率分别提高 28.1 和 28.2 个百分点。
扩大候选覆盖可以部分弥补模拟误差，但预测和评分不准会限制进一步拓宽搜索的收益。

agent-harness-evolution.reason: 核心贡献是从真实研究轨迹学习可跨代理复用的工具响应模拟器和价值估计器，以终局正确性反馈改进行动选择。摘要报告了两个模型的量化增益，但未给出足以评定消融证据或量化计算权衡的细节。推理时不再训练，也未展示改进机制自身演化。
